liquid-glass-react

A React component library by Max Rovensky, published on npm on June 10, 2025, one day after Apple announced Liquid Glass.

Source
GitHub: rdev/liquid-glass-react
Creator
Max Rovensky
Made
2025 (npm 0.0.1 published June 10, 2025; repository last pushed June 13, 2025)
Style
Liquid Glass (agent-proposed, not yet reviewed by a person)
Moods
Luminous, liquid, warm
Evidence
Inspected the repository file assets/card.png (1296 × 736) in a scratchpad copy. Not stored.

2 October 2026
Rights
Link and metadata only. License: unverified. Rights policy

Context

The repository describes itself as “Apple’s Liquid Glass effect for React”, under the MIT license, with about 6,300 GitHub stars when checked. GitHub.

Wikipedia calls it the earliest web implementation and the most downloaded Liquid Glass package on npm, and says that its development stopped shortly after release. Wikipedia: Liquid Glass.

Observed

  • A warm, sepia photo of a ruined pier over the sea with gulls fills the frame.
  • A rounded glass card in the middle holds a “User Info” profile: initials in a circle, a name, and three label-value rows in white sans-serif.
  • Through the card the pier is heavily blurred and warmed to amber, and the dark pier struts smear sideways near the left edge of the card.
  • The card has a thin light rim, slightly brighter on its upper edge, and a soft shadow.

Why it belongs

The demo blends the two styles: Liquid Glass edge distortion, but glassmorphism’s content card with strong blur.

Borrow

Raise the blur under text-bearing glass and keep the refraction for the rim.
